# Outline golden provenance

These byte-exact JSON envelopes are generated by the Rust `ooxml` binary from
the committed fixtures enumerated in `tests/outline.rs`:

```sh
UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 cargo test --test outline family_outlines_match_twenty_deterministic_fixture_goldens
UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 cargo test --test outline_check_surfaces outline_and_check_envelope_schemas_match_platform_independent_goldens
```

The matrix contains six PPTX, eight XLSX, and six DOCX fixtures. It includes
depth, text-preview, slide, sheet, and section variants. Inputs use
repository-relative paths, and `envelope-schema.json` records value-free JSON
types, so no session ID, temporary path, duration, or host-specific field is
frozen. `.gitattributes` pins every JSON file in this directory to LF.

The XLSX table and name inputs are generated through normal mutation commands;
`generated_xlsx_table_and_name_outline_fixtures_are_reproducible` proves that
their committed bytes remain reproducible. Review every changed field before
committing an update.
